$comment: Scholarly conjectures the Bible text does not settle: possibly_same_as (two entries may be one; not same_as) and possibly_attested_at (an unnamed figure in a verse may be the entry; not attested), with each opinion for or against, by source location (see sources.json). Built into the source entry's `conjectures`, with a status: supported (an authoritative source identifies or suggests it, none rejects it), disputed (authoritative sources disagree), rejected (an authoritative source rejects it, none is for it), doubted (authoritative sources only doubt it), unsupported (only non-authoritative opinions). A conjecture never changes attested verses or same_as.
